caption: The drawing depicts a hand-cranked egg beater, composed of several distinct elements. The beater has two long, cylindrical handles with a wood grain texture and brown coloring, set parallel and extending downward. Above the handles, there is a metal gear mechanism featuring interlocking gears and a central crank. The gears are rendered in shades of brown and gray, with visible teeth and circular shapes. Extending from the gear mechanism is a wire whisk comprised of multiple curved, intersecting metal wires, shown in rust-brown tones. The background is a plain, slightly yellowed, beige or off-white color with minimal shading, and there are some faint brownish spots above the object. The composition is centered, with the beater positioned vertically and slightly offset to the right, occupying the upper central part of the image.
title: Cake Batter Mixer
